messages:
violet: Quick poll: which oddly specific soundtrack pairs best with impulse snack-eating during late-night bug hunts? 
omar: 'Rushmore' OST + microwave popcorn. iconic.
lucy: anything by Ennio Morricone + salt-and-vinegar chips = cinematic crunch.
dan: synthwave + leftover pizza. dramatic chewing.
violet: vote with emoji: 
  \u2728 = Rushmore/popcorn
  \u2b50 = Morricone/chips
  \ud83d\udd25 = Synthwave/pizza
jukebox-bot: created short playlist for each combo: https://open.spotify.fake/mini-list#rushmore, #morricone, #synthwave
omar: \u2728 from me. also GIF of Max Fischer eating popcorn.
lucy: \u2b50 lux for the chips.
dan: \ud83d\udd25 for synthwave. gonna bring the rogue pizza slice to the table.
violet: tally: Rushmore 1, Morricone 1, Synthwave 1. tie! deciding tie-breaker: which single track should be on repeat?
omar: "Ned Rifle" theme (Rushmore)
lucy: "The Ecstasy of Gold" but for chips (yes weird)
dan: "Turbo Killer" (synth banger)
violet: ok will rotate tracks every 10min tonight. tiny social in kitchen at 21:00 for anyone pulling a midnight shift 37d
jukebox-bot: reminder posted for kitchen meetup 21:00 (auto-message).
